description: Verify that TCP in LISTEN sends RST in response to incoming SYN+ACK with the seg.ack as RST seq (RFC 793 §3.9 p65)
approach:
[Objective]
A SYN,ACK arriving at LISTEN is unexpected (no peer asked us to send a SYN). RFC 793 §3.9 says DUT must reply with RST whose seq = the unsolicited SYN,ACK's ack number.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN,ACK with ack=K.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: RST with seq == K.
4. Tester → DUT: fresh SYN → DUT must SYN,ACK (LISTEN survived).

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted RST seq == seg.ack AND LISTEN survives.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_seq — RST seq is not seg.ack
• Fail_timeout — no DUT RST to SYN,ACK
• Fail_p2_no_synack — LISTEN socket did not survive RST emission

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted RST seq=ack to SYN,ACK in LISTEN — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_seq: DUT RST seq not seg.ack in LISTEN
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT RST to SYN,ACK in LISTEN
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_synack: LISTEN socket did not survive RST emission
